complaints.theme: Inconsistent drink builds — grounds in mocha, watered-down milk/ice ratio, watered-down iced tea, burnt/flavorless brewed coffee
quotes: Every time I go here, there is a considerable amount of coffee grounds in my mocha. This is concerning, as it typically indicates a lack of cleaning. Their milk to ice ratio is also off, meaning you get a watered down drink.
I always get a turtle mocha blended, I was feel that they make it wrong, or just not currently.
Espresso was good and of course iconic but latter was watered down and too milky.
the coffee coming out of the spigot is flavorless and bitter - it all tastes the same
over the last couple years their has been so burnt as to be undrinkable... it tastes like I'm drinking ash.
The sweeteners were not labeled and were kind of a mess. I was extremely disappointed to find that there were no calorie free sweeteners available
My drink was nasty
Famous place but drinks are never that great

complaints.theme: This location isn't on the Dunn Bros app/rewards network and its menu differs from the chain — customers repeatedly blindsided
quotes: they don't have the same menu as the rest of the Dunn Bros locations and they don't use the Dunn Bros rewards app either... I'm unable to get this when I go here.
this is the first Dunn brothers location, because of this, they don't allow you to use the app, redeem rewards, discounts or promotions. I learned this the hard way!
this is the ORIGINAL Dunn Brothers, yet their own app cannot be used here. So, if you have any Dunn Brothers credit, don't plan on using it here; it's not even possible to do so.
I wanted the spiced honey nirvana. I was informed they are not part of the chain. They tried to make it, but turned it into a cold drink. Its a hot drink. Kind of disappointed

complaints.theme: Parking is confusing — some reviewers report none, others describe a free lot and an alley entrance nobody has published
quotes: Reliable, great coffee, parking sux. Good service.
Indoor seating still closed off due to the COVlD scam, no parking, bakery case is always pitiful looking.
Parking can be a little tough but great little neighborhood area.
Free small parking lot direcrly to the east of it (accessible through alley). Great parking in adjacent Grand Snelling Business Association parking lot.

pastries if you get there before they run out

Consistently terrible internet service. It's soooo bad I have had to leave the business on many occasions.

gifts.title: The Original Dunn Bros: what's different here, one page
gifts.for_complaint: This location isn't on the Dunn Bros app/rewards network and its menu differs from the chain
gifts.deliverable: A one-page printable sign for the counter/door plus a matching web page explaining: this is the founding 1987 location, independently owned and roasted on-site daily, not connected to the corporate app/rewards system, and which chain-menu items (honey matcha latte, spiced honey nirvana) aren't offered here — framed as why it's better, not an apology.
gifts.inputs_needed: Their own live website copy at dunnbrosgrand.com (200 OK, public) plus the OSM listing details already gathered
gifts.why_they_stop_and_read: Five reviews across nine years say some version of 'I learned this the hard way' about the app — this turns a recurring 1-star surprise into pride on the door before anyone orders.

gifts.title: Where to actually park at the Grand Ave Dunn Bros
gifts.for_complaint: Parking is confusing — some reviewers report none, others describe a free lot nobody has published
gifts.deliverable: A simple map page and matching printable sign showing the free lot east of the building via the alley and the adjacent Grand-Snelling Business Association lot, with a walking arrow from each to the front door.
gifts.inputs_needed: Public satellite/map imagery of 1569 Grand Ave (Google Maps or OpenStreetMap, no login) plus the lot descriptions volunteered in their own reviews
gifts.why_they_stop_and_read: Their own customers already published the answer ('free small parking lot directly to the east... through the alley') across a decade of reviews, and it's never once made it onto a sign or their site — this just prints what their happiest customers already told everyone else.

gifts.title: Bar card for the exact drink mistakes customers named
gifts.for_complaint: Inconsistent drink builds — grounds in mocha, watered-down ratios, flavorless brew
gifts.deliverable: A printable espresso-bar reference card listing the specific failure points customers quoted — check the portafilter basket before pulling into a mocha, measure ice before milk on iced drinks, label the sweetener station — as quick visual checkpoints, not a recipe rewrite.
gifts.inputs_needed: Nothing beyond the review text itself — the defects are already described in customers' own words
gifts.why_they_stop_and_read: This is the highest-count, most severe complaint (grounds in the drink, 2-star), spanning 2019 to 2026 — a card built entirely from what their own paying regulars diagnosed, not a generic SOP template.
